units.source_text: 薰君于夜深时分告辞返京。

en.t: Lord Kaoru took his leave late at night and returned to the capital.

units.source_text: 想起了八亲王忧愁苦闷、担心死期将至之状，深觉可怜，准拟在朝廷公务忙过之后再去访问。

en.t: Remembering how the Eighth Prince had been sunk in anxious sorrow and fearful that death was near, he felt deep pity for him and planned to visit again once his court duties had eased.

units.source_text: 匂兵部卿亲王想在今年秋天赴宇治看红叶，正在左思右想，找寻适当机会。

en.t: Prince Niou, the Minister of War, wanted to go to Uji that autumn to see the crimson leaves, and was turning the matter over in his mind as he looked for a suitable chance.

units.source_text: 他不断地遣使送情书去。

en.t: He kept sending messengers there with love letters.

units.source_text: 但二女公子认为他不是真心求爱，所以并不讨厌他，只把这些信看作无关紧要的四时应酬之文，也时时给他回信。

en.t: But the two young ladies thought he was not courting them in earnest, so they did not dislike him; they merely treated his letters as harmless seasonal courtesies and replied from time to time.
